units: decimal MB of complete sparse binary, including topology
memoryEstimate: Planning allowance only: 3 x file size + 128 MB for parser copies, values and runtime overhead. Not a measured device requirement or guarantee.

proposals.name: Browser Max
proposals.target: Desktop browser; opt-in download, not default on phones
proposals.addedCircuits: Pin-aware attack/support masks, overloaded-defender warnings, broader fixed mating-net patterns
proposals.promotionGate: Beat Atlas+ on a new disjoint puzzle sample and paired matches; measure peak memory and p95 latency on real target devices before release. No zero-padding or hidden search.

proposals.name: Laptop Pro
proposals.target: Consumer laptop, 8 GB RAM or more; native optimized sparse evaluator preferred
proposals.addedCircuits: More candidate-conditioned tactical relationships, pawn races/opposition and additional narrowly validated endgame specialists
proposals.promotionGate: Substantive held-out improvement over Browser Max, measured CPU/memory on a laptop, and reproducible no-search computation. May require a more memory-efficient compiler.

proposals.name: Laptop Lab
proposals.target: Research option for laptops with 16 GB RAM or more; not recommended until Pro earns its size
proposals.addedCircuits: Wider compositional tactical circuits rather than repeated copies of existing heuristics
proposals.promotionGate: Proceed only if gains per added megabyte justify latency. Requires chunked assets/compiler, raised validated format bounds and a hosted distribution strategy; no strength claim in advance.
